title: Flow Hive Harvest Readiness Window
dataSources: Hive metrics (`flowhive:reading`), egg counter events (`eggcounter:event`), goat RFID visits (`goattag:scan`), goat watering and feed logs (`goatcare:event`), and compost readings (`compost:reading`).
app: Smallholding and backyard telemetry from Flow Hive scales, chicken coop counters, RFID goat tags, compost thermometers, and camera-driven chore logs sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flowhive:reading
| search capped_frame_pct=*
| stats latest(capped_frame_pct) as capped_frame_pct latest(weight_kg) as weight_kg by hive_id
| sort 0 - capped_frame_pct
value: Capped-frame readiness is a more practical harvest cue than guessing from a single inspection note.
implementation: Send harvest readiness events to `index=personal` and keep `hive_id` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of harvest readiness by hives.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which hivess stand out most for harvest readiness.
